entry.name: mc.channelcount~
entry.description: mc.channelcount~ outputs the number of channels in a multichannel signal connected to its inlet. Any message sent to its inlet triggers the channel count out its left outlet. A signal reports the channel count out the right outlet when the audio is turned on.
